stem: Under what condition should Salbutamol be administered via a nebulizer rather than an MDI and spacer for acute asthma?

options.text: In all cases of severe asthma to ensure rapid delivery.
Whenever Ipratropium is also being administered.
Only when the patient has mild asthma but prefers the mask.
When the asthma is life-threatening or the patient cannot use an MDI.

explanation: Nebulization is the preferred route for life-threatening scenarios or when the physical distress prevents effective MDI use.
rationale: Consider the severity levels or physical limitations that would make a spacer and inhaler impractical.

optionExplanations.A: Studies show MDIs with spacers are as effective as nebulizers for severe asthma unless the patient cannot use the MDI.
optionExplanations.B: Ipratropium can also be delivered via MDI for severe asthma; nebulization is not mandatory based solely on the drug type.
optionExplanations.C: Nebulization is generally reserved for more critical situations or inability to use standard devices, not patient preference in mild cases.
optionExplanations.D: Nebulization is the preferred route for life-threatening scenarios or when the physical distress prevents effective MDI use.

source.hint: Consider the severity levels or physical limitations that would make a spacer and inhaler impractical.
